{"id": "INC-001", "title": "Server returns 500 error on POST /api/auth/login after latest deployment", "severity": "P1 - Critical", "affected_service": "python-service", "environment": "staging", "reported_by": "Frontend QA Team", "timestamp": "2026-09-12T10:00:00Z", "description": "After the latest deployment to staging, users are unable to log in. The POST /api/auth/login endpoint returns a 500 Internal Server Error for all login attempts, even with valid credentials.", "error_log": "Traceback (most recent call last):

INC-002.title: Double discount deduction applied during checkout calculation
INC-002.text:
{"id": "INC-002", "title": "Double discount deduction applied during checkout calculation", "severity": "P1 - Critical", "affected_service": "python-service", "environment": "production", "reported_by": "Finance & Billing Team", "timestamp": "2026-09-12T11:30:00Z", "description": "Customers are being undercharged during checkout when promotional discount codes are applied. For example, a $100 cart with SAVE20 (20% off) results in a total of $64.80 instead of the expected $86.40 (including 8% tax). Analysis indicates the discount deduction is being applied twice to the subtotal.", "error_log": "AssertionError: assert 4.8 == 6.4
File 'app/services/payment_service.py', line 26, in process_order_total
    discounted_subtotal = max(0.0, (subtotal - discount) - discount)
Total mismatch: expected $86.40, received $64.80", "tags": ["billing", "checkout", "discount", "finance", "payment"], "recent_changes": "Commit 38a19f: Refactored promotional coupon calculations in checkout workflow", "expected_behavior": "A $100 cart with 20% discount and 8% tax should have subtotal $80.00, tax $6.40, and total $86.40", "actual_behavior": "Discount is deducted twice from subtotal resulting in $60.00 base, $4.80 tax, and $64.80 total"}
